worldcombat.skill.thunderbolt.summary: Compress a charge into a bolt and fire it in a straight line; it bursts into an electric net on impact, and in spread mode the discharge is shared with enemies around the landing point. A hit may paralyse the target. Electric types are immune to paralysis.
worldcombat.skill.thunderbolt.descriptio: The bolt flies in a straight line at targets within %1$s blocks, dealing about %2$s special Electric damage on a hit at %3$s blocks per tick; it only steers a little, so a hard sideways move escapes it.

The impact bursts over %1$s blocks, and a target that actually takes damage has a %2$s%% chance to be paralyzed for %3$s. Paralysis halves movement speed and gives each attempted action a 25%% chance to fail; Electric types are immune, and the status can be cleansed.
worldcombat.skill.thunderbolt.spread.on: Spread mode: the burst reaches up to %2$s further enemies (each takes %1$s of the direct hit as damage only, with no separate paralysis roll), widening the burst but flying slower, adding 2 wind-up and lengthening the cooldown, while the direct hit is x0.82.
worldcombat.skill.thunderbolt.spread.off: Focused: the bolt strikes only its target, x1.06 direct damage and a faster flight, with no sharing.
worldcombat.skill.thunderbolt.timing: Range %1$s, windup %2$s, recovery %3$s, costs %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.thunderbolt.growth.0: From level %1$s the power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.thunderbolt.growth.1: From level %1$s the paralysis chance rises to %2$s and the burst reaches %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.thunderbolt.use.1: Tag a crowd and share the discharge with its neighbours
worldcombat.skill.thunderbolt.use.2: Open from a distance before closing
worldcombat.skill.thunderbolt.preference: On: the burst shares its discharge with nearby enemies (each takes a fraction of the power), widens the burst x1.5, adds 2 windup and cooldown x1.15, but the direct hit is x0.82. Off: a focused hit at x1.06 that flies faster.
Beyond this distance the companion closes in instead of firing; larger values open from further away.
When on, a target with neighbours gets priority so spread mode can carry the discharge across; when off, it ranks as an ordinary ranged attack.
When on, targets not yet paralysed rank a little higher, so the small paralysis chance is not spent on someone already pinned; when off, all threats rank the same.
